question: Can an axolotl regrow the lens of its eye after the lens is removed?
options: No, at no stage of life
answer: Only as a young larva, about two weeks after hatching. Suetsugu-Maki and colleagues found young larvae rebuild a lens from cells of the iris, but the ability vanishes as they grow; newts keep it all their lives. Axolotls had long been said to lack it, a verdict drawn from animals past that early window.
move: Ask when in life an ability was tested before declaring it missing.
trap: Trusting the long-standing verdict, reached by testing only older animals.
